dedupe_keys.name: sierra leone energy model inputs and hydropower scenarios 2018 2050

description: This deposit contains an Excel input workbook and reference-energy-system diagram for Sierra Leone power-sector modelling. Climate Compatible Growth researchers work with the Ministry of Energy to assemble utility information, public sources and scenario constraints, with particular attention to hydropower expansion. The article describes a 2018–2050 modelling horizon and the use of MAED demand analysis and OSeMOSYS supply modelling. Zenodo provides the workbook and PNG diagram free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is a national planning representation; projected parameters and proposed Bumbuna developments are assumptions, not completed infrastructure or observed future demand. The two-file release does not by itself establish an executable version of either model. A reviewer-assessed use is building or comparing least-cost national electricity scenarios. model-osemosys is the documented supply-model environment. No workbook formulas, scenario feasibility or model reproduction were checked, and no data files were downloaded.
name: Sierra Leone energy-model inputs and hydropower scenarios, 2018–2050
